title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S11 Smart Book Cover, White
amazon_match_notes: Verified exact match: Samsung EF-BX730PWEGUJ, UPC 198957233753. The Woot ASIN B0FKMTM6WF resolves to the same white Tab S11 Smart Book Cover, US version.

comparisons.notes: Official page for EF-BX730PWEGUJ, color White, priced at $94.99. The page shows a delivery option and no out-of-stock notice.

writeup: Samsung's official Galaxy Tab S11 Smart Book Cover in white, model EF-BX730PWEGUJ (UPC 198957233753), snaps onto the tablet magnetically and props it up in portrait or landscape. Woot has this cover for $9.99. Samsung's own US site lists that same white cover at $94.99 and shows a delivery option with no out-of-stock notice, so this is about 89% less, or roughly $85 off. Woot is showing 3+ left, with a limit of 3 per customer, and did not list a condition on the offer.
